title: Olúfẹ́mi O. Táíwò on magical thinking and elite impunity...
content: Olúfẹ́mi O. Táíwò on magical thinking and elite impunity. “We are ruled by a class of people who seem either to believe or presume that war, disease, and apocalyptic destruction are things that will only ever happen to poorer and browner people.”
author: Jason Kottke
